notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
General bug-fixes and added features:


 Added music volume setting
 Added reset button for quickly resetting the level (thanks TGO)
 Changed back button in level to be an exit icon instead (mainly to make it smaller).
 Reduced camera rotation sensitivity somewhat.
 Intro sequences in levels can now be sped up by pressing ESC.
 Fixed issue with collider not being big enough on Hot Hot Hot.
 Fixed bug with CrowdControl overlay displaying a red bar with timed effects.
 Fixed issue with bees being able to spawn inside colliders in edge cases.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
General bug-fixes and added features:

* Fixed UI issues with Todo list in various levels.
* Sausage is now pushed downwards if it's about to leave the level upwards.
* Lowered default volume of background music on "fine sausage" level.
* Fixed issue with sausage sometimes getting torque from nowhere.
* Fixed sound effect falloff range for sausage slaps.
* Added settings menu and moved graphics settings there.
* Reduced force required to pull the drawer out of the sausage wagon.
* Modified win condition triggers on "Sausage and bun" level. Should be more consistent now.
* Modified win condition on "Fine sausage" level so that you need to keep the plate on the table for a bit longer before counting as "done".

"Free the sausage" level fixes:
* Fixed some issues with camera seeing out of bounds.
* Fixed sound doppler effect going bananas when opening vault door.
* Fixed some issues with not being able to attach balloons and bees to sausages when looking through the wall at the end of the corridor.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
Latest update fixes some minor issues.

* Reduced depth of field slightly on "Passionate Precision" level.
* Improved collider for the plate in "Fine Sausage" level.
* Fixed sliding sausage in "Fine Sausage" level.
* Tutorial now shows how to rotate the camera for a little longer, since people seem to miss it every now and then.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
Latest update fixes some bugs and minor issues.

* Fixed bug which made the camera tracking become a bit offset if the sausage was far outside the view.
* Fixed bug with "No support required" achievement.
* Camera now focuses on the object that goes outside of the play area if the player looses.
* Fixed soft-lock where plank in "passionate precision" could fall down, without the game ending.
* Various other minor fixes.
